header: Get an access token using PowerShell
content:
# This code gets the application context token and saves it to a file named
"Latest-token.txt" under the current directory.
$tenantId = '' # Paste your directory (tenant) ID here
$clientId = '' # Paste your application (client) ID here
$appSecret = '' # Paste your own app secret here to test, then store it in a safe
place!
$resourceAppIdUri = 'https://api.security.microsoft.com'
$oAuthUri = "https://login.windows.net/$tenantId/oauth2/token"
$authBody = [Ordered] @{
resource = $resourceAppIdUri
client_id = $clientId
client_secret = $appSecret
grant_type = 'client_credentials'
}
$authResponse = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri $oAuthUri -Body $authBody -
ErrorAction Stop
$token = $authResponse.access_token
Out-File -FilePath "./Latest-token.txt" -InputObject $token
return $token
